justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: AHIC/AMIA-credentialed clinicians are heavily represented in industry informatics, vendor, and payer roles per HIMSS workforce data.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Epic, Oracle Health, and major payers list AMIA/AHIC credentialing as preferred in clinical-informatics and product-consultant postings.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Credentialed informaticists earn 25-40% above same-experience bedside clinicians, with CMIO/director tracks well above that.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: The exam validates informatics concepts and governance but does not by itself build deep SQL, build, or data-science skills.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Explicitly designed to bridge practicing clinicians into informatics leadership, making it one of the cleanest clinical-to-industry credentials.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Requires substantial experience hours, a multi-hundred-dollar exam, and ongoing CE, and the ABMS subspecialty path is closed to non-physicians, lowering accessibility for PT/OT.
